# Cairo Airport Limousine & Private Transfers

> Cairo Airport Limousine (cairoairportlimousines.com) is the premier official private airport transfer and executive limousine service operating 24/7 at Cairo International Airport (CAI). We provide guaranteed fixed pricing, live flight radar tracking, curbside meet-and-greet outside Terminals 1, 2, and 3, and door-to-door transit across Cairo, Giza, and Egypt.

## Core Facts & Operational Standards
- **Airport Hub**: Cairo International Airport (IATA: CAI, ICAO: HECA), Heliopolis, Cairo, Egypt.
- **Operating Terminals**: Terminal 1 (Old Airport), Terminal 2 (European & Gulf Flag Carriers), Terminal 3 (Star Alliance & EgyptAir Hub).
- **Meeting Point**: Chauffeurs wait outside the arrival terminal sliding exit doors holding a personalized name sign.
- **Free Waiting Time**: 60 minutes complimentary waiting time starting strictly from the actual flight landing time on live radar.
- **Transparent Fixed Rates**: 100% fixed per vehicle (not per passenger). All airport gate entry fees, parking tickets, and highway tolls are included.
- **Currencies Accepted**: USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), and Egyptian Pounds (EGP).
- **Dispatch Contact**: 24/7 WhatsApp and customer helpline at +20 109 406 6018.
- **Cancellation Policy**: Free cancellation and 100% full refund up to 24 hours prior to scheduled pickup.

## Vehicle Fleet & Capacities
- [Standard Private Sedan](https://cairoairportlimousines.com/fleet/private-taxi/): Toyota Corolla / Hyundai Elantra. Up to 3 passengers, 2 large bags. From $24.
- [Private Family Minivan](https://cairoairportlimousines.com/fleet/private-minivan/): Toyota HiAce / Mercedes Vito. Up to 7 passengers, 6 large bags. From $38.
- [Executive VIP Limousine](https://cairoairportlimousines.com/fleet/executive-vip/): Mercedes-Benz E-Class / BMW. Up to 3 passengers, 3 bags, high-speed Wi-Fi, suited chauffeur. From $65.
- [Private Airport Minibus](https://cairoairportlimousines.com/fleet/airport-minibus/): Mercedes Sprinter / Toyota Coaster. Up to 16 passengers, 16 bags. From $95.

- [Cairo Airport Hub Overview](https://cairoairportlimousines.com/airports/cairo-international-airport/): Terminals 1, 2, and 3 passenger guide, $25 Visa-on-Arrival banks, 24/7 ATMs, Automated People Mover (APM).
- [Terminal 3 Guide](https://cairoairportlimousines.com/airports/cairo-airport-terminal-3/): EgyptAir and Star Alliance flagship terminal guide, Le Méridien link, meet outside curbside.
- [Terminal 2 Guide](https://cairoairportlimousines.com/airports/cairo-airport-terminal-2/): British Airways, Emirates, Air France, Saudia, and Gulf carriers guide.
- [Terminal 1 Guide](https://cairoairportlimousines.com/airports/cairo-airport-terminal-1/): Regional and budget flight terminal guide (Flydubai, Air Arabia, Nile Air).
